datasets.name: market_annual
queryLines: SELECT area, period, index_value, level_lo, level_hi, growth_yoy, endpoint_pairs, period_state FROM gold.v_market_index WHERE frequency = 'annual' ORDER BY area, period

datasets.name: county_band
queryLines: SELECT period, 'Index' AS series, index_value AS value FROM gold.v_market_index WHERE geography_id = 'scope' AND frequency = 'annual' UNION ALL SELECT period, 'Lower 95%', level_lo FROM gold.v_market_index WHERE geography_id = 'scope' AND frequency = 'annual' UNION ALL SELECT period, 'Upper 95%', level_hi FROM gold.v_market_index WHERE geography_id = 'scope' AND frequency = 'annual'

datasets.name: precision
queryLines: SELECT threshold, metric, round(value, 3) AS value, accepted_labelled_pairs, round(ci_lo, 3) AS ci_lo, round(ci_hi, 3) AS ci_hi FROM gold.v_linkage_precision ORDER BY metric, threshold

datasets.name: score_bands
queryLines: SELECT CAST(band AS STRING) AS band, candidate_pairs, rule_based_links FROM gold.v_link_score_bands WHERE cell_state = 'shown' ORDER BY band

datasets.name: quality
queryLines: SELECT CAST(sale_year AS STRING) AS sale_year, disposition, occurrences, cell_state FROM gold.v_data_quality ORDER BY sale_year, disposition

datasets.name: sensitivity
queryLines: SELECT experiment, geography_id, pairs, properties, growth_window, round(log_growth, 3) AS log_growth, round(shift_vs_headline, 3) AS shift_vs_headline, round(max_level_gap, 3) AS max_level_gap, example_200k_2015_sale_in_2025 FROM gold.v_sensitivity ORDER BY geography_id, abs(shift_vs_headline) DESC

datasets.name: sens_series
queryLines: SELECT experiment, period, index_value FROM gold.v_sensitivity_series WHERE geography_id = 'scope' AND frequency = 'annual' AND experiment IN ('baseline', 'deterministic_links', 'method_huber', 'threshold_0.3', 'threshold_0.9', 'with_new_first_leg', 'exclude_unusual')

datasets.name: cso
datasets.displayName: Donegal index and CSO Border houses
queryLines: SELECT CASE WHEN experiment = 'baseline' THEN 'Repeat-sales (Donegal)' ELSE 'CSO RPPI Border houses' END AS series, period, index_value FROM gold.v_sensitivity_series WHERE geography_id = 'scope' AND frequency = 'annual' AND experiment IN ('baseline', 'cso:border_houses')

datasets.name: benchmark
queryLines: SELECT benchmark, geography_id, frequency, periods, metric, round(value, 3) AS value, compared_periods, caveat FROM gold.v_benchmark ORDER BY geography_id, frequency, periods, metric

datasets.name: backtest
queryLines: SELECT eval_window, method, metric, round(value, 3) AS value, pairs FROM gold.v_backtest WHERE segment = 'common' ORDER BY eval_window, metric, method

datasets.name: calibration
queryLines: SELECT horizon_band, level, round(coverage_test, 3) AS coverage_test, n_test, round(relative_width, 2) AS relative_width, status FROM gold.v_calibration ORDER BY horizon_band

datasets.name: vintages
queryLines: SELECT release_id, period, index_value FROM gold.v_vintages WHERE geography_id = 'scope' AND frequency = 'annual' AND period_state <> 'suppressed'

datasets.name: revisions
queryLines: SELECT release_id, previous_release_id, geography_id, frequency, period, round(previous_value, 2) AS previous_value, round(value, 2) AS value, round(log_revision, 5) AS log_revision, cause FROM gold.v_revisions ORDER BY created_at DESC, geography_id, frequency, period

lines: Published series only (2015 = 100). Suppressed periods are blank. Bands are 95% property-history bootstrap intervals of the **index**, not of any one home. The newest period is provisional. Release state: 'published' means every gate passed, including the frozen link threshold; 'research' means it is still provisional.

frame.title: Which series are published, and why not

lines: Precision is measured from human labels of a stratified sample, weighted by inverse sampling probability; the interval is on unweighted counts. Denominators are the labelled pairs at or above each threshold. 'final_links' rows measure the links that survive clustering (what the index uses); 'labels' rows are raw pair scores.
Every register row is kept and assigned one disposition. Cells under 10 are suppressed (small-cell rule).

frame.title: Register rows by year and disposition

lines: ## How much do the choices matter?
Each experiment rebuilds histories, pairs and the index from the same linkage scores with one choice changed. Shifts above 0.05 log points are flagged for investigation, not used to pick a result.

The CSO RPPI is a benchmark, not ground truth: it covers household purchases, is hedonic and regional. Growth rates are compared. The backtest predicts each sale from an index fitted without that property and without later data (retrospective, not real-time).

frame.title: Donegal repeat-sales index and CSO Border houses (2015 = 100)
